meta.promptText: Which brand's formal shirts should I buy for men in India?

response.text:
If you want **good formal shirts for men in India**, I’d rank the brands like this:

1. **Van Heusen — best overall** ⭐  
   Excellent balance of fit, fabric, office-appropriate styling, and price. A particularly safe choice if you want shirts for everyday corporate wear. Current examples are around ₹1,000–₹2,500 depending on the model/sale. [midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

   ### [Van Heusen Men Solid Slim Fit Formal Shirt]()
*₹1,029*

2. **Louis Philippe — best premium choice**  
   Choose this if you want a more refined, executive look and don't mind paying more. [midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

   ### [Louis Philippe Men Shirt]()
*₹1,724*

3. **Arrow — best for classic, very formal dressing**  
   Particularly good if your workplace has a conservative dress code or you regularly attend client meetings. [midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[verosmart.in](https://verosmart.in/blogs/style-guide/best-office-wear-brands-for-working-professionals-in-india-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

4. **Peter England — best value for money**  
   A strong choice if you're building a wardrobe on a budget. You can find decent formal shirts well below ₹1,500. [midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

   ### [Peter England Men Formal Shirt]()
*₹797*

5. **Raymond — best for classic/premium feel**  
   Worth considering if you prefer traditional, understated formalwear. [midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

6. **Allen Solly — best for slightly less conservative offices**  
   Good if your workplace is business-casual rather than strictly corporate. [midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[verosmart.in](https://verosmart.in/blogs/style-guide/best-office-wear-brands-for-working-professionals-in-india-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My recommendation

If you're buying **5 shirts**, I'd do:

- **2 × Van Heusen** — white + light blue
- **1 × Louis Philippe** — white or pale blue for important meetings
- **1 × Arrow** — light blue/white
- **1 × Peter England** — another everyday colour

For formal shirts, **fit matters more than the logo**. Look for a clean shoulder fit, enough room around the chest/waist, a collar that sits neatly, and preferably cotton or a breathable cotton blend. [dressingschool.com](https://dressingschool.com/picks/formal-shirts/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me your **budget per shirt (e.g. ₹1,000, ₹1,500, ₹2,000, ₹3,000)** and whether you're **slim/regular/heavy build**, I can narrow it down to the **best 3–5 shirts to buy right now**.
